description: M10, the pre-registered profile likelihood in the semi-major axis under Student-t errors (docs/notes/M10.md): the site's copy of docs/notes/M10_profile.json. Q is on the χ² scale; Δ ln L = −ΔQ/2.

status_codes.0: the maximum number of function evaluations was reached (not converged)
status_codes.1: gtol satisfied: the scaled gradient is below 1e-10
status_codes.2: ftol satisfied: the relative change of the cost in the last step is below 1e-10
status_codes.3: xtol satisfied: the relative step is below 1e-10

error_model: Student-t errors (ν = 4) with the scales of the Student-t sensitivity run

profile_vs_s3_posterior.reading: partial: no reading beyond the curves

rows.text: A is partial or missing under Student-t: no row is used; the curves and the failed clause are reported.
A is not constrained under Student-t: (iii)/(iv) are not read; the leave-one-out sets are reported as curves only.

a_x_b_student_t.text: A profile is partial: the table is not used.
